elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code demonstrating regex extraction from a text string. The code imports the 're' library, defines a data string describing a phone purchase, uses regex patterns to extract 'product', 'model', and 'price' from the string, and prints these extracted values. The output shown is: product: iPhone 12 model: A2172 price: $799.
elements.summary: This code example illustrates how to use Python's regex library to parse and extract specific information (product name, model, price) from a text string for data retrieval purposes.
